findings.evidence: Line 72 proves `IsNullHomologous γ a b (∅ : Set ℂ) → IsNullHomologous γ a b Ω`; line 79 proves the general `IsNullHomologous.mono (hΩ : Ω ⊆ Ω')`.
findings.fix: Move `IsNullHomologous.mono` before this lemma and prove it as `h.mono (empty_subset Ω)`.
findings.issue: `IsNullHomologous.of_empty` unfolds the predicate and duplicates the later general monotonicity lemma.

findings.evidence: Line 86 assumes `Ω'ᶜ ⊆ Ωᶜ`; line 79 already provides the natural monotonicity API under `Ω ⊆ Ω'`.
findings.fix: Derive it from `h.mono` using the standard complement-subset equivalence, e.g. convert `Ω'ᶜ ⊆ Ωᶜ` to `Ω ⊆ Ω'` and call `h.mono`.
findings.issue: `IsNullHomologous.mono_compl` is only the complement-subset reformulation of `IsNullHomologous.mono`, but repeats the definition-level proof.

summary: Two lemmas reprove special cases or reformulations of the monotonicity theorem instead of deriving them from the general API.
